description: An artboard: a named page rectangle on the document's canvas. Art is not owned by an artboard; an artboard shows whatever lies inside its rectangle.

id.description: The artboard's id, unique among the document's artboards and stable for its life. The node_id of this node is `artboard-<id>`.

rect.description: The artboard's rectangle in document points (1/72 inch), y down.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

show_center_mark.description: An editor shows a mark at the artboard's centre. Absent: false.

show_cross_hairs.description: An editor shows cross hairs through the artboard's centre. Absent: false.

title: core.vector.artboard - one artboard of a vector-art/1 document
